message: every episode ready to upload today would air with no English caption track, because no usable captions/<slug>.srt is committed for it: how-strong-is-graphene. Uploading one would schedule a video this repo can never caption.
unblock:
The .srt is derived from the narration audio, which only exists on the Mac that voiced the episode:

  python visuals/captions.py <slug>

then commit captions/<slug>.srt (and the .vtt, .chapters.txt and .timing.json it writes beside it). This lane picks the episode up on the run after they land. Nothing is deleted meanwhile: the render stays on the R2 shelf.
disposition_why: 'CAPTIONS_NOT_READY' is not in loop/stop_policy.json, so it is treated as needing a human. That is the default on purpose.
notes: quota allows 3 of 4 today. quota day 2026-09-08 (PT): spent 0 of 10000, 9600 usable after 400 headroom; lanes: none
refused 1 episode(s) with no usable English .srt: how-strong-is-graphene. They stay on the shelf; nothing is deleted.
